title: IssueLighter: An Issue Type-Aware LLM Agent for Issue Report Validity Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2611.02721v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Invalid issue reports are prevalent in open source software (OSS) projects, imposing substantial burdens on maintainers who already face a high risk of burnout. Prior research has primarily focused on identifying invalid reports for specific issue categories (e.g., bug and wontfix), leaving the broader landscape of OSS issue types largely unexplored and limiting the generalizability of existing approaches. Moreover, existing methods provide little support for explaining or validating their predictions, reducing their practical usefulness for maintainers. With the rise of LLM-based agents, it remains unclear whether a comprehensive understanding of the causes of invalidity across all issue types can improve validity assessment performance while producing well-grounded rationales. To this end, we first manually annotated the validity status of 520 issue reports from three OSS projects, i.e., pandas, scikit-learn, and mypy, result

translated_title: IssueLighter：一种感知问题类型的LLM智能体，用于问题报告有效性评估
translated_abstract: 无效的问题报告在开源软件项目中普遍存在，给已经面临高度倦怠风险的项目维护者带来了沉重负担。以往的研究主要集中于识别特定问题类别（例如bug和wontfix）中的无效报告，而对开源软件更广泛的问题类型尚缺乏探索，这限制了现有方法的泛化能力。此外，现有方法在解释或验证其预测方面提供的支持很少，降低了它们对维护者的实际实用性。随着基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的兴起，对所有问题类型的无效原因进行全面理解能否在提升有效性评估性能的同时产生有充分依据的理由，目前仍不清楚。为此，我们首先人工标注了来自三个开源软件项目（即pandas、scikit-learn和mypy）的520份问题报告的有效性状态……
tldr: 该论文提出IssueLighter，一种感知问题类型的LLM智能体，通过全面理解各类问题的无效原因来评估开源项目问题报告的有效性，并提供有充分依据的理由，从而减轻维护者的负担。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes IssueLighter, an issue type-aware LLM agent that assesses the validity of issue reports across all issue types based on a comprehensive understanding of invalidity causes, while providing well-grounded rationales to ease the burden on maintainers.
